dataItem-m7iaafg2.text: The problem occurs when I save to disk as a USD file—it crashes due to a lack of memory. To address this, I customized the settings by reducing the voxel size and density to optimize memory usage. I also deleted some attributes to make the file lighter and checked the 16-bit option in the Pyro Solver.

dataItem-m7iamklq.text: Use OpenCL to improve the simulation speed.

dataItem-m7iaqi0w.text: After deleting those redundant attributes, the computer increases its performance.

dataItem-m7ib5wkv.text: Since my smoke simulation is simply floating smoke in the environment, I can safely delete attributes related to fire, combustion, and extra calculations to optimize performance.
